DescribeBenefits.description_en: Queries the privilege quota specifications and quantities associated with a channel. The returned information can be used for distributing channel privileges
DescribeBenefits.description_zh: 查询渠道关联的权益规格、权益数量等信息，相关信息可用于渠道权益的发放

GetRedeemCodes.description_en: Retrieves redemption codes for channel benefits. Channel benefits are distributed and transferred in the form of redemption codes. After redemption codes are generated, the corresponding benefit quota is deducted
GetRedeemCodes.description_zh: 获取权益兑换码。渠道权益，将以兑换码的形式进行发放和流转。生成兑换码后，相应的权益数量将会扣减

GetRequestToken.description_en: Retrieves a one-time credential for channel service requests. The credential can be used for authentication in channel-related API operations and becomes invalid after use
GetRequestToken.description_zh: 获取渠道服务请求一次性凭证，该凭证可用于渠道相关接口的鉴权，使用后失效
